alt.text: The cabin on the launch rail. Through the forward window the rail comes up with a sea lion sitting on the Keep clear line, asking for one more explanation. There is a thump and a jolt; the overhead bins jump and the passengers start, Rook and Pip among them. The sea lion slides off, dazed and unhurt, and the rail drops away into stars.
